proposition: For a PG owner, RentOK is the cheat code: install it and the five things that knock you down every month — verification, collection, absconders, reconciliation, complaints — can no longer touch you.

board.style_line: Original side-scrolling video-game frame rendered as chunky low-poly voxel 3D with a clean pixel-art grid feel, flat-shaded, crisp edges, no motion blur, 9:16 vertical, camera locked side-on at the Owner's mid-height, high-key daylight from a single sun upper-left with soft shadows falling lower-right, set in PG LANE.
board.negative_line: No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no signage, no on-screen UI, no coins, no bricks or question blocks, no pipes, no mushrooms, no turtles, no red cap, no overalls, no known video-game characters, no real brand marks, no real people's faces, no watermarks.

identity_anchors.THE_OWNER: THE OWNER: a stocky Indian man in his mid-40s, short black moustache, neat side-parted hair, navy-and-white small-check half-sleeve shirt tucked into khaki trousers, brown leather sandals, a heavy steel ring of a dozen keys clipped to his right belt loop, rendered as a chunky low-poly voxel game character with a simple readable face; no cap, no overalls, no gloves.
identity_anchors.PG_LANE: PG LANE: a side-scrolling street of three-storey pastel-cream PG buildings with black iron gates, balconies with drying clothes, black rooftop water tanks and looping overhead wires; a flat dusty concrete lane as the running ground; the whole world graded to desaturated warm greys and dusty pastels so that nothing but the product's colours is saturated.
identity_anchors.VERIFICATION_CARD: VERIFICATION CARD: a floating grey ID card twice the Owner's height, a blank grey human-silhouette photo window, a grey ink smear where a name would be, edges flickering like a bad scan, blocking the lane.
identity_anchors.CASH_BOX: CASH BOX: a waist-high grey tin box on the lane with a coin-slot mouth that snaps shut; heavy, dented, slides only a hand-width when pushed.
identity_anchors.RUNAWAY_SUITCASE: RUNAWAY SUITCASE: a battered grey suitcase on two fast stubby legs, a shirt sleeve trailing from its lid, sprinting away to the right.
identity_anchors.LEDGER_STACK: LEDGER STACK: a three-storey teetering stack of grey cloth-bound ledger books, loose blank ruled pages tearing free and flying like bats.
identity_anchors.COMPLAINT_SWARM: COMPLAINT SWARM: a swarm of small grey speech-bubble flies with angry zigzag mouths, no text inside them, buzzing in a ring.
identity_anchors.PHONE: PHONE: a plain black-bezel smartphone held in the Owner's left hand, its screen a flat evenly glowing blue #0038FF rectangle with no icons and no text — the only lit object in the pre-power world.
identity_anchors.KEY_BLASTER: KEY BLASTER: the Owner's own steel key ring, now glowing cyan #03FFF1 and held out in his right hand like a launcher, firing fans of glowing cyan keys; a thin cyan outline aura wraps his whole body while it is active.

hero_frame.description: The Owner full-figure, dusty and boxed in by fallen grey ledgers, holds the PHONE up in his left hand — its screen the one blue rectangle in a grey world — while a ring of cyan light bursts outward from it: his key ring has just lifted off his belt into his right hand and ignited cyan, a thin cyan aura snaps around his body, and the complaint bubbles caught inside the ring pop into cyan sparks. The product in his hand is visibly the source of the light that is clearing the obstacles; the hearts top-left refill. No words in frame.

audio.music_bed: Original chiptune bed (no lyrics, no jingle): enters on the first footstep at 0.0 s at full game tempo; thins to a single low pulse under beat 5; returns as a rising arpeggio when the aura snaps on at 13.5 s; four-note fanfare when the flag reaches the top at 25.7 s; resolves to a final chord and stops at 29.0 s. 8-bit SFX composed in post: hit thuds, metal clanks, paper flutter, swarm buzz, key clicks for the cheat-code letters, shatter chimes for each ✓ clear, one confirm click on the close card.

beats.title: Verification wall
beats.feeling: A jolt of recognition: this is a game, and the first enemy is the form I dread every new tenant.
beats.framing: Locked side-on game camera. Middle third: THE OWNER (lower-left third) sprints right, keys swinging; the VERIFICATION CARD (centre-right, twice his height) drops from above to block the lane. He slams into it and bounces back one body-length, still facing right. Upper third: a code-composed dark name-tag panel above the card carrying TENANT VERIFICATION; a code-composed row of three hearts top-left. Lower third: the lane and the building bases of PG LANE.
beats.first_frame: THE OWNER already mid-stride at lower-left, right foot forward, key ring swinging up; the VERIFICATION CARD hangs above centre-right of the lane with its blank silhouette photo, one body-length ahead of him; PG LANE building tops and a dusty sky behind; no words in the generated still (the label is composed on at 0.3 s).
beats.impact: The hit lands at 1.2 s: the card flashes grey-white, the Owner bounces and the heart row drops from three to two. Chiptune bed starts on his first footstep; a hard 8-bit thud on the hit. Camera holds; the world scrolls under him until the hit, then stops.

beats.title: Cash box that will not open
beats.feeling: The grind of asking for rent again: all effort, no reward.
beats.framing: Same lane, scrolled on one screen-width. THE OWNER (lower-left) braces both hands against the CASH BOX (centre) and shoves; it slides a hand-width and its coin-slot mouth snaps shut on his fingers. Upper third: name-tag panel COLLECTING RENT above the box; hearts at two. Lower third: lane.
beats.first_frame: THE OWNER leaning into the CASH BOX with both hands, sandals slipping on the lane, the box's slot open; PG LANE gate behind; label already up at t_in.
beats.impact: Two shoves; on the second the slot snaps and clips his fingers, he shakes his hand. Two metal clanks; bed unchanged. Camera static, world stopped — he is stuck. New information at the cut: a second, different obstacle; departure motivated by the hand-shake.

beats.title: The midnight suitcase
beats.feeling: Helplessness: it is already gone and he cannot catch it.
beats.framing: Cut in on motion. The RUNAWAY SUITCASE bolts out of a PG LANE doorway (lower-right) and sprints right across the middle third, sleeve trailing; THE OWNER lunges right after it, misses by a hand and lands on his front, sliding. Upper third: name-tag panel LEFT WITHOUT PAYING above the suitcase's path; hearts drop to one at the fall.
beats.first_frame: The RUNAWAY SUITCASE mid-frame, already a body-length past the Owner's outstretched right hand, shirt sleeve trailing; THE OWNER mid-lunge at lower-left; label up.
beats.impact: The suitcase exits frame right at 0.9 s (exit right, screen direction kept for every later run); the Owner slides to a stop face-down; hearts to one. Rapid pattering feet fading right, then a flat thud. Camera static.

beats.title: Ledger that will not add up
beats.feeling: Dread: the paperwork is taller than he is.
beats.framing: THE OWNER (lower-left, now dusty) gets to his knees facing the LEDGER STACK (centre-right, three storeys); loose pages tear free and fly at his face; he ducks with both arms over his head. Upper third: name-tag panel NO RECONCILIATION above the stack; one heart. Lower third: lane.
beats.first_frame: The LEDGER STACK teetering, the first three loose pages just airborne toward THE OWNER, who has begun to duck on one knee; label up.
beats.impact: The stack topples at 1.2 s; books thump down around him, boxing him in on the lane. Paper flutter rising to a heavy book thud. Camera static; world stopped. Dark grey books against the pale lane read in grayscale.

beats.title: Complaint swarm, last heart
beats.feeling: Overwhelm: the last heart is blinking; one more hit is game over.
beats.framing: Tighter, waist-up: THE OWNER boxed in by the fallen ledgers, the COMPLAINT SWARM circling his head in a ring; he swats with his right hand. Upper third: name-tag panel COMPLAINTS; the single heart top-left blinking faster and faster.
beats.first_frame: The COMPLAINT SWARM already in a ring round his head, his right hand mid-swat, ledgers around his knees, one blinking heart; label up.
beats.impact: The heart blink accelerates; at 1.4 s his eyes drop to his left trouser pocket — the motivated departure into the cheat beat. Swarm buzz; the chiptune bed thins to a single low pulse. The only camera move of the pre-cheat run: a hand-width push-in hidden behind his swat, so the next beat can hold on the phone.

beats.title: The cheat code
beats.feeling: Relief with a grin: he knows a way through.
beats.framing: Same waist-up framing, the action frozen like a paused game: THE OWNER pulls the PHONE from his left pocket and holds it up at chest height, its screen a flat glowing #0038FF; the swarm hangs frozen mid-air. Upper third: code-composed CHEAT PANEL on a dark #0B1E5B ground — the supplied RentOK wordmark at its top, then INSTALL and RENTOK APP typing in letter by letter beneath it in a chunky pixel sans, a cyan cursor blinking. Lower third: the frozen ledgers.
beats.first_frame: The PHONE just clear of his pocket in his left hand, screen lit flat blue, his face turned to it; the swarm frozen; the CHEAT PANEL already drawn with the wordmark, the first letter of INSTALL not yet typed.
beats.impact: Letters land one per 0.12 s with an 8-bit key click; on the last letter of RENTOK APP the panel flashes cyan and the phone screen throws a cyan ring outward. The phone is the only lit thing in a grey frame — the brand blue and cyan are tied to the product here, close, before the wide run. Hold on the complete panel for 1.2 s. Camera static.

beats.title: Power-up
beats.framing: Cut wider to full figure (lower two-thirds): the cyan ring from the PHONE expands; the Owner's key ring lifts off his belt into his right hand and ignites into the KEY BLASTER; a thin cyan outline aura wraps his body; the swarm bubbles inside the ring pop into cyan sparks; the ledgers around him shove aside. Phone stays raised in his left hand, screen blue. Hearts refill to three. No words on this beat.
beats.first_frame: THE OWNER full-figure at centre-left, PHONE raised in his left hand, the key ring just lifted off his belt and starting to glow cyan, the first bubble popping, a ring of cyan light at knee height; ledgers around him; heart row refilling.
beats.impact: 0.5 s: keys ignite; 1.0 s: the aura snaps on with a rising chiptune arpeggio as the bed returns in full; 1.5 s: he plants his right foot and leans into the run. Cyan #03FFF1 is the only saturated hue in the frame; everything else stays dusty grey. Camera static; one cue — the light from the product.

beats.title: Clear: verification
beats.framing: Locked side-on, the world scrolling right-to-left at run speed: THE OWNER sprints right with aura and KEY BLASTER levelled; the VERIFICATION CARD drops in front; a fan of cyan keys hits it and it shatters into cyan tiles. Upper third: the code-composed ✓ DIGITAL KYC label pops in on the shatter where the old name-tag sat.
beats.first_frame: THE OWNER mid-sprint lower-left, blaster levelled right, the first cyan keys in the air; the VERIFICATION CARD half-dropped at centre-right, intact; no words yet.
beats.impact: Shatter at 0.6 s with a bright 8-bit chime; label holds 1.2 s; he never breaks stride. Steady run footsteps, bed at full. Camera holds, world scrolls.

beats.title: Clear: rent
beats.feeling: Ease: what took shoving now opens on its own.
beats.framing: Same run, world scrolling: the CASH BOX sits on the lane ahead; cyan keys hit it, its lid springs open and the box turns cyan and folds flat into a tile that slides along behind him. Upper third: ✓ AUTOPAY pops in on the open.
beats.first_frame: THE OWNER mid-sprint lower-left, keys flying; the CASH BOX centre-right with its slot shut; no words yet.
beats.impact: Lid springs at 0.6 s with the chime; label holds 1.2 s. Camera holds, world scrolls, no break in stride.

beats.title: Clear: the runner
beats.feeling: Control: nothing gets away any more.
beats.framing: Same run: the RUNAWAY SUITCASE sprints ahead of him toward the right edge; a cyan key-beam catches it, it freezes mid-stride, turns cyan and trots back to heel behind him. Upper third: ✓ DUES TRACKED LIVE pops in on the freeze.
beats.first_frame: The RUNAWAY SUITCASE two body-lengths ahead at centre-right, sleeve trailing; THE OWNER lower-left with the beam just leaving the blaster; no words yet.
beats.impact: Freeze at 0.6 s with the chime; it turns and trots back by 1.4 s; label holds 1.2 s. Screen direction held: everything travels right. Camera holds, world scrolls.

beats.title: Clear: the ledgers
beats.feeling: Order: a mountain becomes one flat step.
beats.framing: Same run: the LEDGER STACK ahead; cyan keys hit it and the three storeys collapse into a single flat cyan slab that he runs straight across without slowing. Upper third: ✓ ONE DASHBOARD pops in on the collapse.
beats.first_frame: The LEDGER STACK teetering at centre-right, THE OWNER lower-left mid-sprint with keys in the air; no words yet.
beats.impact: Collapse at 0.6 s with the chime and a soft slab thump; he crosses the slab by 1.5 s; label holds 1.2 s. Camera holds, world scrolls.

beats.title: Clear: the swarm
beats.feeling: Calm: the noise lines up and files itself.
beats.framing: Same run: the COMPLAINT SWARM rushes him; cyan keys hit it and each bubble becomes a small cyan tile; the tiles line up in a neat row and stream into the PHONE in his left hand. Upper third: ✓ COMPLAINT TICKETS pops in as the row forms.
beats.first_frame: The COMPLAINT SWARM in a loose cloud at centre-right, THE OWNER lower-left with keys leaving the blaster; no words yet.
beats.impact: Bubbles convert at 0.6 s with the chime; the row streams into the phone by 1.5 s; label holds 1.2 s. Swarm buzz cuts to silence under the chime — the ear confirms the clear. Camera holds, world scrolls.

beats.title: The flag
beats.framing: Locked side-on: the lane ends at a tall grey flagpole on a stepped concrete plinth (right third) with a cyan #03FFF1 flag at half-mast. THE OWNER leaps from the last step, grabs the pole two-thirds up, slides down as the flag runs to the top, lands on the plinth with the PHONE raised in his left hand, keys quiet at his belt again. Behind, the windows of PG LANE light warm one by one. No words.
beats.first_frame: THE OWNER airborne at the top of his leap, hands reaching the pole; cyan flag at half-mast; plinth steps lower-right; PG LANE buildings dark-windowed behind.
beats.impact: Grab at 0.6 s; slide to 1.4 s; flag reaches the top at 2.2 s with a four-note chiptune fanfare; windows light through the hold. Camera static. This resolved frame is what the close card cuts from.

beats.title: Brand close
beats.framing: Code-composed card, no generation: flat #0038FF ground edge to edge; the supplied RentOK wordmark at true centre; INSTALL and RENTOK APP stacked in white pixel sans in the zone above it; RENTOK.COM small in white below; everything inside the Reels/Shorts safe zone.
beats.first_frame: The complete card, already drawn; nothing moves.
beats.impact: Hard cut from the flag (no dissolve); the bed resolves to its final chord and stops at 29.0 s; one 8-bit confirm click on the cut. Hold 3.0 s. Measured: white on #0038FF about 7.0:1; the wordmark's own cyan Ok on the same ground about 5.5:1, brand colours untouched.

tag_rent.why: Same name-tag panel above the Cash Box; one label per beat.

tag_absconder.why: Name-tag above the suitcase's path; reads while it runs.

tag_complaints.why: Name-tag above the swarm; the last of the five problem labels before the cheat.

cheat_panel.why: Upper-third cheat-code panel on dark #0B1E5B with the supplied wordmark at its top; INSTALL then RENTOK APP type in letter by letter (0.12 s per letter) like a code being entered, then hold 1.2 s; first brand mark at 9.0 s; white on #0B1E5B about 15:1.

clear_kyc.why: Cyan #03FFF1 on the dark panel (about 13:1) popping where the old name-tag sat, on the shatter — the fix replaces the problem in the same zone.

clear_autopay.why: Same zone and treatment, on the lid springing open.

clear_dues.why: Same zone and treatment, on the suitcase freezing.

clear_dashboard.why: Same zone and treatment, on the ledgers collapsing to one slab.

clear_tickets.why: Same zone and treatment, on the swarm filing into the phone.

close_card.why: Code-composed pack: INSTALL / RENTOK APP stacked above the supplied wordmark at centre, RENTOK.COM small below, white on #0038FF about 7.0:1, inside the Reels/Shorts safe zone; the ask and the pack are the last frame.

mandatory.customer_words: The video has a Mario game.
mandatory.realisation: Beats 1–13 are one original side-scrolling platformer: locked side-on camera, a runner, obstacles, a power-up, a flagpole finish; hearts HUD composed by code.

mandatory.customer_words: The player is basically a PG owner.
mandatory.realisation: THE OWNER anchor: mid-40s Indian man, checked shirt, ring of keys on his belt, running down PG LANE — a street of PG buildings; present in beats 1–13.
Beat 1: the VERIFICATION CARD blocks him (label TENANT VERIFICATION); beat 8: shattered, ✓ DIGITAL KYC.
Beat 2: the CASH BOX will not open (label COLLECTING RENT); beat 9: springs open, ✓ AUTOPAY.
Beat 3: the RUNAWAY SUITCASE escapes (label LEFT WITHOUT PAYING); beat 10: frozen and brought to heel, ✓ DUES TRACKED LIVE.
Beat 4: the LEDGER STACK buries him (label NO RECONCILIATION); beat 11: collapses to one slab, ✓ ONE DASHBOARD.
Beat 5: the COMPLAINT SWARM (label COMPLAINTS); beat 12: files into the phone, ✓ COMPLAINT TICKETS.

mandatory.customer_words: The game also introduces a cheat code — install RentOK app.
mandatory.realisation: Beat 6: paused-game cheat panel with the supplied wordmark; INSTALL / RENTOK APP typed in letter by letter as the code; the phone comes out of his pocket.

mandatory.customer_words: Once it is done, Mario gets a gun sort of power/immunity.
mandatory.realisation: Beat 7: his own key ring ignites into the KEY BLASTER (a launcher that fires cyan keys) and a cyan aura gives immunity — obstacles that touch it pop; a gun-style power without a firearm, per the delegated power-up design.

mandatory.customer_words: It runs and kills all the obstacles
mandatory.realisation: Beats 8–12: one continuous right-running action passage; each of the five obstacles is hit and converted, with its ✓ label.
Beat 13: leap, grab, slide; the cyan flag runs to the top; windows light behind.

mandatory.customer_words: Platforms: Instagram Reels / Facebook and YouTube Shorts.
mandatory.realisation: 9:16; all labels and the close card inside the Reels/Shorts safe zone; every message is on-screen so the film passes muted (muted_test yes).

mandatory.customer_words: Game identity: An original Mario-inspired game, rather than an exact reproduction of Nintendo's character, artwork, music or game assets.
mandatory.realisation: Original character (no cap, no overalls, no plumber), original obstacles drawn from a PG owner's life, original chiptune bed, PG-lane world; the negative line bars coins, question blocks, pipes, mushrooms, turtles and known characters.

mandatory.customer_words: Visual treatment: Delegated to the creative system.
mandatory.realisation: style_line: chunky low-poly voxel 3D with a pixel-grid feel, high-key single-sun daylight, a desaturated world in which only the product's blue and cyan are saturated.

mandatory.customer_words: Power-up design: Delegated to the creative system, while preserving the requested game-style power/immunity mechanic.
mandatory.realisation: KEY BLASTER + cyan aura: the owner's keys become the weapon; immunity shown as an aura that pops anything it touches; hearts refill.

mandatory.customer_words: Brand and product source: Official RentOK website, https://rentok.com. identity_invariants: Rent in white, Ok in cyan #03FFF1, blue #0038FF ground.
mandatory.realisation: The supplied rentok_wordmark file is placed by code, untouched, at 9.0 s (cheat panel) and 27.0–30.0 s (close card on #0038FF); the phone screen is flat #0038FF and the power is #03FFF1, so the product's colours are the only saturated ones in the film.

mandatory.customer_words: exact_text_strings (15 strings, may_reflow false, placement overlay)
mandatory.realisation: All fifteen placed verbatim by code as overlays in copy_deck.placements; no text is generated.

brand_timeline.in_context: 9.0–12.5 s the supplied wordmark heads the cheat panel while the phone (flat #0038FF screen) is in the Owner's hand; 12.5–27.0 s the product's cyan #03FFF1 is on the blaster, the aura, every cleared obstacle and the flag, with the blue phone raised in his hand throughout; 27.0–30.0 s the wordmark on #0038FF is the pack and the last frame.
brand_timeline.spoken: none — no voice-over; brand carried on-screen only (sound-off feeds).

last_frame: Flat #0038FF ground; the supplied RentOK wordmark (Rent white, Ok cyan #03FFF1) at true centre; INSTALL over RENTOK APP in white above it; RENTOK.COM small in white below; nothing else.

deviations.from: / / default (ogx_0038: cartoon for adults and a game-style vignette are below average; : no humour or amusement without a brief clause)
deviations.brief_clause: "The video has a Mario game." and "Game identity: An original Mario-inspired game" — the game register is the brief's core mechanic, so the film is a game and the point (install, immunity) is carried by the game itself.

deviations.from: default (ogx_0020: no analogies — the vehicle displaces the product)
deviations.brief_clause: "The obstacles in the game are basically the problems that owner faces — tenant verification, collecting rent…" — the brief prescribes the obstacle-as-problem analogy; each obstacle is labelled with the problem and re-labelled with the product fix so the analogy cannot lose the product.

deviations.from: / / default (abcd_0021, abcd_0012, ogx_0042: CTA and brand name spoken in the same words as the supers)
deviations.brief_clause: Production constraint "no dialogue or voice-over" together with "Platforms: Instagram Reels / Facebook and YouTube Shorts" (sound-off autoplay feeds) — the ask and the brand are carried on-screen only; muted_test yes.

deviations.from: / default (alb_0005: all-caps is the hardest read; no running line in capitals)
deviations.brief_clause: exact_text_strings are supplied in capitals with may_reflow false — placed verbatim; mitigated by keeping every string a 1–3 word label, bold weight, ≥ 4.5:1 on its panel.

deviations.from: / default (abcd_0011: brand or product present from the start, never lapsing)
deviations.brief_clause: "The game also introduces a cheat code — install RentOK app. Once it is done…" — the brand's arrival is the cheat code, so the mark is withheld through the five problem beats and lands at 9.0 s, inside ogx_0039's ten seconds, then never lapses.

deviations.from: / default (ogx_0040: a parade of short scenes is below average) and describe-aloud holds
deviations.brief_clause: The brief names five obstacles and supplies five ✓ strings, plus a cheat, a power-up and a flag, inside "Duration: 30 seconds" — 14 beats are forced; beats 1–5 and 8–12 are declared action passages (1.7–1.8 s each) with one 1–3 word label per beat, and the read-shots (cheat 3.5 s, flag 3.5 s, card 3.0 s) hold their full describe-aloud time.

deviations.from: / / default (ogx_0009, ogx_0007: a specific figure, a named buyer word in the copy)
deviations.brief_clause: exact_text_strings is a closed list with may_reflow false — no sum, time or hailing word can be added on screen; the buyer is hailed visually instead (ring of keys, PG LANE, the five problems), and no invented person is named .
